# Terracore Stones

> Terracore Stones is a buyer's agent inside India for natural stone procurement, QA and logistics. We are not a trader and not a middleman — we are engaged directly by international buyers to act as their own presence in India, paid for consultancy, QA and logistics, never for the material.

## About

- **What we do:** Supplier & quarry audits, production QA, container sign-off, and export logistics for natural stone sourced in India.
- **Who we serve:** Architects, interior designers, and developers in India, Mauritius, Australia, and the UAE.
- **Founder:** Kush Sharma, 15+ years embedded in India's natural stone trade.
- **Model:** No markup on material. We are paid a consultancy fee for our services, so our incentive is aligned with the buyer.

## Materials we source

- [Marble](/marble.html) — premium Indian marble with on-ground QA
- [Granite](/granite.html) — durable Indian granite
- [Limestone](/limestone.html) — soft, natural warmth for facades and flooring
- [Basalt](/basalt.html) — dense, dark volcanic stone for cladding and paving
- [Custom Fluted Finish](/fluted.html) — fluted stone panels and finishes
- [Custom Furniture](/furniture.html) — bespoke stone furniture
- [Custom Inlay Work](/inlay.html) — stone inlay and marquetry
- [Outdoor & Cladding](/outdoor.html) — exterior stone and cladding
- [Pool & Deck](/pool.html) — pool coping, decking and wet-area stone
- [Wall Panels](/wallpanel.html) — stone wall panels and feature walls
- [Mosaic](/mosaic.html) — stone mosaic tiles and patterns

## How we work

1. **Supplier & quarry audits** — we vet quarries and factories against your spec and inspect raw blocks for hidden flaws before a single cut.
2. **Production QA** — on-ground during your run, enforcing dimensional tolerances and confirming shade and vein consistency via dry-lays.
3. **Container sign-off** — no container is sealed without our personal inspection of packing, lashing, and aesthetic uniformity.
4. **Export logistics** — documentation, ISPM 15 compliance, and port coordination from factory floor to destination port.
